Bombay HC: Working spouses must share family expenses equally

The Bombay High Court ruled that working husbands and wives must equally share household expenses and the cost of a child's education. The court stated that equality cannot be claimed selectively. This ruling emphasizes the principle of equal responsibility in marriage for financial matters. The decision was reported by multiple centrist English-language outlets.
